messages:
incident-bot: [P1] ALERT - multi-node GPU instability in prod-ssd-gpu (us-west2). Symptoms: repeated NVIDIA Xid resets (145/31), ECC correctable bursts, and serving-runtime OOMs with kv_cache checksum errors. Affected hosts: gpu-node-07, gpu-node-08, gpu-node-09, gpu-node-11, gpu-node-13, gpu-node-14. Error rate increase on /v1/generate and multiple pod restarts. Paging oncall now.

mike: ack, I'm oncall. what's the immediate customer impact?

incident-bot: Error rate up ~2.8% for /v1/generate, p99 latency +400ms, ~12 pod restarts in last 15m. Some Dedicated tenants saw 5xxs. Kernel logs show Xid and runtime logs show "kv_cache: checksum mismatch" entries.

sam: jumping in, pulling node logs and kube events. tagging infra.

sam: ```
Mar 15 12:05:11 gpu-node-07 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:03:00): 145, GPU has fallen off the bus.
Mar 15 12:05:11 gpu-node-07 runtime[pid]: ERROR kv_cache: checksum mismatch for segment 0x4
Mar 15 12:05:12 kubelet: Container runtime error: OOMKilled
```

julia: any correlation with a driver rollout? deploy-bot, any recent driver changes?

deploy-bot: Deploy: nvidia-driver:v525.60 rolled to us-west2 nodes 03/14 23:10 UTC (automated canary -> roll).

tara: can we get ECC counters from affected hosts? `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` pls.

sam: running ECC query now, output snippet: ```
GPU 0 ECC errors:
  Volatile:  correctable: 124, uncorrectable: 0
GPU 1 ECC errors:
  Volatile:  correctable: 98, uncorrectable: 1
```

mike: uncorrectable error on GPU1 is worrying — could be hardware. Immediate mitigations: cordon + drain affected nodes, redirect traffic to other regions/pools, enable model fallback/quantized variant to reduce memory pressure.

sam: I'm cordoning gpu-node-07 and gpu-node-11 now. Drain command: `kubectl drain gpu-node-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`; setting annotation `redwood/evac=live` on pods so they pick up graceful fallback.

julia: also set routing override to prefer dedicated-pool-2 and enable fallback policy so requests go to replicas in us-east for impacted tenants.

mike: CSMs — two enterprise tenants reported errors; open customer bridge and notify high-touch contacts.

mike: creating customer bridge now -> #customer-bridge-123 (bridged to Zoom).

incident-bot: Bridge created: https://zoom/bridge/3412.

sam: short-term remediation idea: restart runtime process on affected nodes to flush kv_cache (avoid reinstalling driver). I'll patch canary pods to disable in-memory kv cache (`KV_CACHE_ENABLED=false`) to see if error rate drops.

tara: risky to hot-reload drivers in-prod. prefer evacuate/reboot then collect diags.

julia: agree — avoid driver reinstallation mid-incident. evacuate, reboot, collect `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,ecc.errors.volatile.corrected --format=csv` and full `journalctl -u redwood-runtime` snapshot.

sam: collecting diags and saving snapshots to /opt/diag/gpu-wave-3369901111.tar.gz. Also opening hardware ticket INC-5892 for GPU1 on gpu-node-08 (uncorrectable observed).

sam: additional kube output: ```
NAME                     READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
inference-pod-abcde      1/1     Running   3          2h
inference-pod-fghij      0/1     Error     2          18m
```

mike: plan of record (short-term):
1) Cordon + drain noisy nodes in small batches (to avoid capacity shock)
2) Restart runtime on drained nodes to clear kv_cache
3) Monitor for new Xid/ECC events for 30m
4) If Xid persists -> hardware eject/swap for GPUs showing uncorrectable ECC and open colo replacement
5) Customer comms + status page update

mike: I'm initiating the cordon/drain for gpu-node-07 now. will update in ~15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

incident-bot: Update: drain started for gpu-node-07 at 12:18 UTC, completed at 12:24 UTC. Pods gracefully evacuated, traffic shifted.

sam: after runtime restart on gpu-node-07 we saw no new Xid on that host for 8m. node-08 is still noisy (multiple Xid in last 10m). opened INC-5892 and notified colo.

julia: post-incident action items: sam + tara to own postmortem; required follow-ups: (A) add kv_cache crc/repair path to runtime, (B) improve alerting to correlate kernel Xid + runtime kv_cache errors, (C) run defensive driver-canary tests before fleet rollouts.

tara: drafting status: "We're investigating GPU driver resets and ECC errors affecting inference in us-west2. We are evacuating noisy hosts and routing traffic to healthy replicas. Some requests may experience increased errors or latency. We'll update in 30 minutes." :pencil:

mike: handing to tara for customer comms and next-oncall. I'll be available during handoff. Good work team. :white_check_mark:

sam: collecting final diag bundle and pushing to S3: s3://redwood-diag/3369901111.tar.gz

julia: marking owners and timeline for postmortem. last update before handoff.

mike: handoff complete — handing to tara (+ oncall rotation). monitoring continues.

incident-bot: Incident thread closed for active paging; follow-up tasks created in TASK-4756.
